name: King Slime
summon: Use it in any biome, at any time. King Slime also spawns on its own during a Slime Rain.

drops.name: Slime Gun

drops.name: Slime Hook
drops.effect: A single-claw grappling hook with slime-green reach.

drops.effect: Vanity shirt from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.effect: Vanity leggings from the ninja trapped inside King Slime.

drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like King Slime's crown and face.

name: Desert Scourge
summon: Use it in the Desert or Underground Desert.

drops.name: Barinade
drops.effect: Fires two converging high-velocity fin arrows that soar through the air.

drops.name: Sandstream Scepter
drops.effect: Fires an explosive stream of sand that detonates when the projectile expires.

drops.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

drops.name: Scourge of the Desert
drops.effect: When used, it throws a javelin that burrows into tiles and launches itself towards the closest enemy when burrowing through tiles. Thrown javelins are slightly affected by gravity and pierce twice.

drops.name: Sand Cloak
drops.effect: Dashing creates a protective sand veil that damages enemies and grants +3 defense and 75% acceleration inside it.

drops.name: Ocean Crest
drops.effect: Recover air while standing still underwater, and 15% increased mining speed while wet.

drops.name: Desert Scourge Mask

unlocks: Sandstorms can now occur naturally, and the Sunken Sea opens up - fish there for the Sparkling Empress and Sea Spirit Amulet, and Giant Clams start to spawn. Prism-Backs begin dropping Prism Shards, and Ghost Bells drop Voltaic Jelly.

name: Eye of Cthulhu
summon: Use it at night to summon the Eye. It can also spawn on its own at night once you have 200 HP and a few defeated town NPCs.

drops.name: Teardrop Cleaver
drops.effect: A broadsword that inflicts Temporal Sadness on hit, sharply slowing enemy movement.

drops.name: Deathstare Rod

drops.name: Demonite Ore
drops.effect: The Corruption world's first upgrade ore; smelt it into Demonite Bars.

drops.name: Corrupt Seeds
drops.effect: Plants a patch of Corruption where used.

drops.name: Crimtane Ore
drops.effect: The Crimson world's first upgrade ore; smelt it into Crimtane Bars.

drops.name: Crimson Seeds
drops.effect: Plants a patch of Crimson where used.

drops.name: Eye of Cthulhu Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Eye of Cthulhu.

drops.name: Shield of Cthulhu
drops.effect: Dash into enemies to damage and knock them back; also cancels fall damage.

blurb: Summoned at night with a Suspicious Looking Eye. It circles and spawns Servants until half health, then stops summoning and charges instead.

summonItem.name: Suspicious Looking Eye
summonItem.effect: Summons the Eye of Cthulhu when used at night.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

name: Crabulon

drops.name: Crabulon Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Crabulon's fungal crab head.

blurb: Fought in the Glowing Mushroom biome. It walks and jumps at the player while firing mushroom projectiles and summoning Crab Shroom minions.

summonItem.name: Decapodita Sprout
summonItem.effect: Summons Crabulon when used inside the Glowing Mushroom biome.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

drops.name: Eater of Worlds Mask

drops.name: Worm Scarf

summonItem.name: Worm Food

summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

drops.name: Brain of Cthulhu Mask

drops.effect: A chance to dodge attacks, and confuses nearby enemies when you are hit.

summonItem.name: Bloody Spine
summonItem.effect: Summons the Brain of Cthulhu when used in the Crimson.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar

drops.name: Weather Pain

drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like Polterghast.

blurb: A ghost boss summoned deep in the Dungeon. It splits into hooked clones and grows more frantic as it loses health.
unlocks: Abyss minibosses begin dropping weapons, and the final tier of the Acid Rain event unlocks. Recommended before challenging the Devourer of Gods.

name: The Old Duke
summon: Fish in the Sulphurous Sea with a Bloodworm (after Moon Lord). It also appears during the final tier of the Acid Rain event, once Polterghast is beaten.

drops.name: Insidious Impaler
drops.effect: Throws self-propelling radioactive harpoons that chase foes.

drops.name: Fetid Emesis
drops.effect: Fires an accelerating stream of bullets until the barrel overheats.

drops.name: Septic Skewer
drops.effect: Launches a chained harpoon infested with toxins.

drops.name: Vitriolic Viper
drops.effect: Charges up and fires a slithering beam of radiation.

drops.name: Cadaverous Carrion
drops.effect: Summons a shark-puking Old Duke head sentry.

drops.name: Mutated Truffle
drops.effect: Summons a younger fishron minion that irradiates your foes.

drops.name: Toxicant Twister
drops.effect: Throws a fan of four spinning disks that swirl around your cursor.

drops.name: The Old Reaper
drops.effect: Throws a scythe that cuts through enemies and deposits unstable isotopes.

drops.name: Old Duke Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Old Duke.

blurb: An optional Acid Rain boss of the Sulphurous Sea. A mutated Duke Fishron that charges and fires sulphurous sharks and toxic bubbles.

name: The Devourer of Gods
summon: Use the Cosmic Worm anywhere, at any time.

drops.name: Maw of Infinity
drops.effect: A blade forged from the Devourer's maw that swings in a 3-hit combo.

drops.name: The Obliterator
drops.effect: A long-reach yoyo that occasionally fires cosmic bolts.

drops.name: Thread of Eradication
drops.effect: Charges up and channels God's Bane Doombeam.

drops.name: Hyperdeath Rift Scepter
drops.effect: Tears space in two with the Hyperdeath Rift Ripper.

drops.name: Void Eater Marionette
drops.effect: Summons a mini Devourer minion under your control.

drops.name: Dimension-Tearing Disk
drops.effect: Throws a disk that tears space toward the nearest enemy.

drops.name: Cosmic Discharge
drops.effect: A whip whose strikes cause glacial explosions and boost your minions.

drops.name: Cosmilite Bar
drops.effect: Top-tier post-Polterghast crafting material for Cosmilite gear.

drops.name: Devourer of Gods Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Devourer of Gods.

blurb: A cosmic worm fought anywhere. In its second phase it teleports through portals and speeds across the arena, forcing constant movement.
unlocks: Opens the path to Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth (the next major boss), and its Cosmilite Bars craft the top post-Polterghast gear.

summonItem.name: Cosmic Worm
summonItem.effect: Summons The Devourer of Gods when used.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil from the three Sentinel materials

name: Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
summon: Use a Blessed Phoenix Egg anywhere at any time
blurb: The immortal jungle dragon and Yharim's loyal guardian, a fiery two-phase gauntlet before the final trials.

name: Exo Mechs
summon: Press the Contact button on a fully completed Codebreaker
blurb: Draedon's ultimate war machines - Ares, Thanatos, and Artemis & Apollo - fought together as one of the two final bosses.

name: Supreme Witch, Calamitas
summon: Interact with an Altar of the Accursed using Ashes of Calamity or a Ceremonial Urn
blurb: The brimstone witch and Calamity's true final boss, an unrelenting bullet-hell duel that caps the mod's progression.
